title: [CQ-I06] Client integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Verify client/daemon reconnects, stale approvals, packaged runtime/provider assets and cross-platform UI contracts.

Deliverable: Client integration and hardening. This is task I06 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): I05, R13, V12, C11.
definitionOfDone: Both clients consume identical daemon verdicts.
Packaged plugins contain all required production helper assets and no test fixtures.
Windows engines and certified host smoke are recorded honestly.
Fresh verification `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:

1. Certified hosts.
- Read docs/CERTIFICATION.md '## Certified platforms' at HEAD. R13 fills it in. At 24a8b95c, every row (win32 x64, linux x64, darwin x64, darwin arm64) read 'unsupported: no report'.
- Read R13's completion and review summaries: moe.get_context {taskId: 'task-f4811a729f9e436ba129a65c12d348c1', view: 'full'}.
- For each row, record the platform and arch, then one of:
  - 'established', quoting the row's Multipass, Image sha256, Supervisor sha256, Finished and Report sha256 cells verbatim;
  - 'not certified', when the row says 'unsupported: no report' or R13's summaries do not establish it. A platform missing from the table is 'not certified' too.
- Never infer, synthesize or edit a report.
- Never run native-smoke or certify. They are operator-only, use real VMs, and this host has no Multipass.
- verified-local stays unavailable.

2. Windows engines. Cite I06f's QA-approved evidence for Windows PowerShell 5.1, pwsh 7 and Windows Node: its completion record and its QA approval comment id. Label each engine with its version. The record names the engines that ran. It is not a claim about wrapper results at later commits.

3. Residual owners.
- V12's client hand-forward. V12b (task-6339299a, DONE) projects latestCheckRun.outcome. JetBrains reads only command, exitCode and source (Models.kt DeliveryCheckRun, MoeJson.kt:440, DeliveryPresentation.kt:22-29), so an exit-0 timeout, infra-failure, skipped or inconclusive run reads as a pass. VS Code renders no latestCheckRun at all.
  - Search moe.search_tasks ('latestCheckRun', 'check outcome') for an owner. The architect found none on 2026-10-31 and gave the governors a filing spec in #architects.
  - Name the owning row's id. If there is still none, record 'unowned: human decision' and @mention the governors in your comment.
- Every residual I06f's whole-epic review listed: copy it with its owner from I06f's completion summary. Treat an ownerless one the same way.

4. Post the whole record as ONE moe.add_comment on this task. That comment is the DoD 3 evidence; keep its id for complete_task.

Error handling: if R13's summaries and CERTIFICATION.md disagree, record both quotes and mark the row 'not certified'. Never resolve a disagreement in favour of a claim.

DoD 1, 2 and 4: keep I06f's evidence fresh, then run THE GATE.

Rules for every run here:
- Never run npm in the shared tree (GLOBAL rail). Use snapshots only, with MOE_* cleared.
- Linux node runs under a Linux-only PATH (`mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate`).
- Kill only pids you started.

1. Freshness.
- B is I06f's last landed commit: `git log moe/work-2026-10-24 -1 --format=%H --grep 'Moe-Task: task-426a012ecc374cdaa7454742bc5a552a'`.
- Run `git diff --stat "$B"..HEAD -- moe-jetbrains moe-vscode scripts/local-runner scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs packages/moe-daemon/src packages/moe-daemon/package.json packages/moe-proxy/src packages/moe-proxy/package.json`.
- Empty: cite I06f's QA-approved evidence for DoD 1 (the VS Code corpus run) and DoD 2 (the packaged checks).
- Non-empty: this is likely, since R13 and V12 land after I06f.
  - Re-run I06f's DoD 1 VS Code run and its DoD 2 packaged-runtime run, exactly as I06f's approved plan words them, in a fresh full-repo `git archive HEAD` snapshot.
  - Fall back to this task's priorAttempt step 3 runs A3 and A5 only if I06f's text is unavailable.
  - Report counts and the commit.
- The JetBrains half of DoD 1 is ClientVerdictCorpusTest inside the gate.

2. THE GATE (DoD 4). This is the one verification command, and its fresh output is the complete_task evidence.
- First acquire the lease: moe.acquire_resource {resourceId: 'jetbrains-gradle', taskId, workerId, note: 'I06 DoD 4 gate'}. If you are queued, report_blocked with that resourceId.
- Release it with moe.release_resource on every exit path, failure included (`mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease`).
- WSL has no JDK, so this is the labelled Windows equivalent of `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test`. If the host has a POSIX JDK, also run the pinned form and report both.

S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/i06-gate-XXXX) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $(wslpath -w "$S")\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun" && R="$S/moe-jetbrains/build/test-results/test" && grep -ho '<testsuite [^>]*>' "$R"/TEST-*.ClientVerdictCorpusTest.xml "$R"/TEST-*.PlanReviewApprovalStateTest.xml "$R"/TEST-*.ManagedVmPresentationTest.xml && ! grep -L 'failures="0" errors="0"' "$R"/TEST-*.xml | grep . && echo "suites=$(ls "$R"/TEST-*.xml | wc -l)"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$S"; echo "GATE_EXIT=$rc"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]

Pass requires all of these:
- GATE_EXIT=0;
- BUILD SUCCESSFUL in the gradle output;
- each of the three suites (all com.moe.toolwindow) printed as a <testsuite ...> tag, with this run's timestamp;
- no TEST-*.xml with a failure or error.
The form follows 007c0ea8 and 08bb7723. The architect did not dry-run it: the lease belongs to working seats.

Error handling:
- 'Could not receive a message from the daemon' is the gradle CLIENT OOM (`mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-client-oom`). GRADLE_OPTS is already set: rerun once and report both runs.
- If rm hits a Windows file lock, leave the scratch dir and name it in the step note.
- Findings: fix forward only in the owning module, at most ~20 lines, and name each file in modifiedFiles. Anything bigger becomes a new row plus report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds.
- Never weaken or skip a test.
- Before calling a red result a regression, rerun it on a pristine archive of the parent commit.

Self-review of the evidence, once, last, before complete_task. Load adversarial-self-review. Read your step 1 comment and the gate output the way QA will:
- DoD 3: every CERTIFICATION.md row appears. Each 'established' row is quoted, not paraphrased. Nothing reads as certified without a report sha256. Nothing claims native-smoke or certify ran here.
- DoD 1-2: the evidence names its commit. If the freshness diff was non-empty, the re-run is at the gated HEAD, not at I06f's.
- DoD 4:
  - the command is labelled as the Windows equivalent;
  - its exit code and output tail are verbatim;
  - the three suite tags prove the suites ran in this run.
- Every residual has an owner id or reads 'unowned: human decision'.
- The jetbrains-gradle lease is released, and every temp copy is removed or named.
- There is no .moe edit, no Git write, and verified-local is untouched.
Then call complete_task with the gate command, its exit code and output tail. Cite the step 1 comment id for DoD 3 and the DoD 1-2 evidence line. Write the Serena memory 'task-task-4e412148225f480c8c0d5a1706a3cc76-handoff' with each DoD's evidence and what remains uncertified.

- vm-control's loopbackDaemonHost admits only 127.0.0.1 and ::1.
- WSL agent mode records bindHost `wsl`, so every VM is kept with reason attempt-unknown (lifecycle.mjs holdReason).
